Calculate the lower calorific value of a coal specimen which contains 6% 10   
hydrogen, from the following data:   
Mass of coal burnt = 1 gm   
Quantity of water in calorimeter = 2.5 kg   
Increase in temperature of water = 2.8°C   
Water equivalent of apparatus = 390 gm.
